[[File:Separatist_munitions_factory.png|thumb|right|280px|The munitions factory.]]
A '''Separatist munitions factory''' designed to manufacture war matériel for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was located on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] within Separatist [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The facility was targeted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] more than once during the conflict, but its powerful [[Force field/Legends|force field]] protected it from any attack. On one occasion, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Attack on the Separatist munitions factory|infiltrated]] the factory and destroyed its force field, but the subsequent assault by a trio of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] was thwarted by the arrival of the Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]''.
